concerns.text: Under-reach: the idea's methodology explicitly requires aggregating TWO sources — 'Download alloy composition data from the Materials Project API' AND 'Retrieve corrosion potential measurements from public NIST Standard Reference Data records'. The spec drops Materials Project entirely and sources composition solely from NIST-IR-8200 (FR-001/FR-002). If this consolidation was a deliberate clarification decision (e.g., MP lacks corrosion-linked composition), the spec must state that rationale; otherwise restore the MP ingestion step or document why single-source NIST composition satisfies the idea's 'aggregates public composition data (Materials Project) and corrosion records (NIST)' framing.

Drift in success criterion: the idea's Expected Results state 'model performance (R² > 0.6) confirming a learnable relationship'. The spec silently redefines learnability as 'R² > 0.0 with p < 0.05' (US-2 SC-3, SC-007). Lowering the bar by an order of magnitude changes what counts as a positive result. Either retain R² > 0.6 as the confirmatory threshold (with R² > 0.0 as a mere learnability floor) or explicitly justify the redefinition relative to the idea's stated expectation.
